contexts.text: Curtains and cords () = spiritual things thence derived.
The curtains of the land of Midian () = a religiosity from falsity.
Curtains and vessels () = the truths (of the Spiritual Church). AC 3762:4. AE 799:12.
Under Curtain, see these references. AC 9595:2.

To stretch out the curtains of the habitations () = the Holy of worship from the truths of faith. ( = to multiply truths. AC 10545:3.) ( = the increasing of the Church as to truths of doctrine. AE 600:12.)
Curtains () = truths proceeding from that good, and covering it.
